entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that performs the PC5 Relay RLC channel release procedure.

entities.name: PC5 Relay RLC Channel Release Procedure
entities.description: Procedure where the UE releases RLC entities and logical channels for specified PC5 sidelink RLC channels.

entities.name: sl-RLC-ChannelToReleaseList-PC5
entities.description: List containing identifiers of PC5 sidelink RLC channels to be released.

entities.name: sl-RLC-ChannelID-PC5
entities.description: Identifier for a specific PC5 sidelink RLC channel.

entities.name: RLC Entity
entities.description: Radio Link Control entity associated with a PC5 sidelink RLC channel.

entities.name: Logical Channel
entities.description: Logical channel corresponding to a PC5 sidelink RLC channel.

entities.name: Current UE Sidelink Configuration
entities.description: Condition that the sl-RLC-ChannelID-PC5 must be part of the current UE sidelink configuration.

relations.description: The UE performs the PC5 Relay RLC channel release procedure.
The procedure uses the sl-RLC-ChannelToReleaseList-PC5 information element.
The list contains one or more sl-RLC-ChannelID-PC5 identifiers.
The procedure requires that the sl-RLC-ChannelID-PC5 is part of the current UE sidelink configuration.
The procedure releases the RLC entity associated with the sl-RLC-ChannelID-PC5.
The procedure releases the logical channel corresponding to the sl-RLC-ChannelID-PC5.
